audit_events_org_required.name: audit_events_org_required
audit_events_org_required.value: "audit_events"."organization_id" is not null or "audit_events"."action" like 'auth.%' or "audit_events"."action" = 'device.claim'

command_targets_reason.name: command_targets_reason
command_targets_reason.value: ("command_targets"."status" = 'failed') = ("command_targets"."reason" is not null) and ("command_targets"."reason" is null or "command_targets"."reason" in ('unsupported', 'permission_required', 'error'))

lessons_ended_consistent.name: lessons_ended_consistent
lessons_ended_consistent.value: ("lessons"."status" = 'ended') = ("lessons"."ended_at" is not null) and ("lessons"."status" = 'ended') = ("lessons"."end_reason" is not null)

policy_assignments_scope.name: policy_assignments_scope
policy_assignments_scope.value: ("policy_assignments"."layer" = 'baseline' and "policy_assignments"."lesson_id" is null) or ("policy_assignments"."layer" = 'lesson' and "policy_assignments"."lesson_id" is not null)

policy_versions_scope.name: policy_versions_scope
policy_versions_scope.value: ("policy_versions"."layer" = 'baseline' and "policy_versions"."lesson_id" is null) or ("policy_versions"."layer" = 'lesson' and "policy_versions"."lesson_id" is not null and "policy_versions"."site_id" is not null)

power_action_targets_reason.name: power_action_targets_reason
power_action_targets_reason.value: ("power_action_targets"."status" = 'failed') = ("power_action_targets"."reason" is not null) and ("power_action_targets"."reason" is null or "power_action_targets"."reason" in ('unbound', 'device_offline', 'wake_unsupported', 'node_missing', 'upstream_unavailable'))

remote_sessions_closed_consistent.name: remote_sessions_closed_consistent
remote_sessions_closed_consistent.value: ("remote_sessions"."status" = 'closed') = ("remote_sessions"."closed_at" is not null and "remote_sessions"."close_reason" is not null) and ("remote_sessions"."closed_at" is not null) = ("remote_sessions"."close_reason" is not null)
